name: google-map-lead-extractor
description: Export business information (name, phone, website, address, rating) already visible in Google Maps search results to CSV, Excel, or JSON.

scripts.package: node build.mjs && rm -f google-map-lead-extractor.zip && cd dist && zip -r ../google-map-lead-extractor.zip . -x '.*' && cd .. && echo 'Packaged -> google-map-lead-extractor.zip'
